description: ShatterLess Technical Design Document — the repo's engineering law. Read for any code change. Obey it over generic Godot patterns and over the `godot` router skill. Covers: Godot 4.7 + Forward Plus + D3D12, GDScript-not-C# decision, Rapier3D + netfox addons, the NetworkTime/NetworkRollback/NetworkEvents autoloads, feature-folder repo layout, typing/naming conventions, and the determinism rules for P2P deterministic lockstep with rollback (no wall-clock, no un-seeded RNG, full state save/restore, simulation on the network tick). Trigger keywords: TDD, architecture, determinism, rollback, lockstep, netfox, RollbackSynchronizer, _rollback_tick, netcode, Rapier3D, GDScript, autoload, conventions, banned API.
